content:
Maya: Quick design review — observed three related issues when saving from the row-edit modal: 1) primary CTA grows when we swap text for a spinner, causing the table row height to jump; 2) toasts are stacking behind the modal on small screens (z-index/pointer-events weirdness); 3) adjusting spacing tokens to fix (1) creates ripple layout shifts in compact tables.

Dom: I can repro the jump. Right now we replace label with spinner which changes width. We should keep button min-width or use an inline spinner that doesn't affect layout. :+1:

Sam: Accessibility: if we keep text+spinner we should update the accessible label instead of removing text. e.g., `aria-live` on the toast + `aria-label` on the button like `Saving…` so screen readers get context.

Alex: For toasts, likely z-index + `pointer-events: none` on the modal backdrop is wrong here. Toasts should be appended to a top-level portal container with higher z-index than modals that are not truly blocking. Also small screens need different stacking rules — can we avoid toasts under modals entirely? :thinking_face:

Maya: I prefer inline spinner option so CTA height is stable. Proposal: keep label, show a 12px spinner left of text, and a subtle opacity animation for disabled state. That avoids width changes.

Dom: Prototype CSS I tried:
```
.btn--primary { min-width: 96px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1); }
.btn--spinner { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--color-foreground); animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite; }
```
Keeps height stable and uses `gap` token so spacing tokens don't mutate layout.

Sam: Agree on keeping text. Also change live region on toasts to `aria-live="polite"` and add `role="status"` for non-interruptive updates. For the button, set `aria-live="assertive"` only if there's an error.

Alex: For toast stacking: moving toasts to `#app-overlays` with `z-index: 1200` and modals at `1100` fixes overlaying. Also ensure modal backdrop uses `pointer-events: auto` but keep toasts clickable with `pointer-events: auto` on the toast element itself. I'll put a small PR.

Maya: Token note — we saw `--space-1` being changed from `8px` to `6px` in a token PR which made compact tables collapse visually. Let's not change global spacing tokens in a hotfix. If we need a smaller gap for CTA spinner, add a component-scoped token like `--btn-gap-sm` instead of mutating `--space-1`.

Dom: Agreed. I'll create `--btn-gap-inline` and default to `8px` for now. I can prototype and push a screenshot in the thread.

design-bot: Screenshot uploaded (link: https://img.redwood.dev/attachments/cta-spinner-proto.png)

Maya: Screenshot looks good. Action items: Dom - small PR for inline spinner + min-width + new token; Alex - toast portal z-index PR; Sam - aria attributes doc blurb; Maya - update the components page with the pattern and a11y notes. Aim to land by EOD Wednesday. :sparkles:

Dom: Will do, assigning myself.

Alex: On it, will include mobile stacking test cases.

Sam: I'll draft the a11y copy and put it in the docs PR.

Maya: Thanks all. Quick follow-up: keep an eye on telemetry for table jank after patch — add a small timing test in the instrumented UI dashboard.
